description: Compare an MCP server endpoint and optional tools/list definitions with stored public records. Facts, not a verdict; no live inspection. MCP request bodies are limited to 32 KiB including the envelope; use POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/record/check/server for offers up to 256 KiB. Each tool result carries its zero-based offer index; guarded names are omitted with nameWithheld=true and no pin. Missing names include a full count and withheld count. Extra tools/list and annotation keys are stripped before matching. Signed fingerprints can be pinned as since in check_tool or watch_tools. History is bounded to 21 public observations and may cover less than 90 days; zero recorded changes is not proof of no change. Each offered tool consumes one Record API request; a server-only look consumes one. Send a key in Authorization. Only /mcp/public offers keyless checks for up to 5 tools when the whole request fits the daily and minute quotas atomically; a refusal consumes none. Get a free agent key: POST https://interfacedelta.com/api/v1/agent-keys
name: check_server
title: First-contact check
